diagnostic_questions.question: Did the applicant complete a master's or PhD degree at an eligible Canadian DLI on or after February 15, 2024?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Eligibility for automatic 3-year PGWP and exemption from field of study requirements
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Applicant is eligible for a 3-year PGWP with no field of study restriction; proceed to assess PGWP application timing
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Determine degree type and program length to assess applicable PGWP duration rule; if bachelor's level, assess field of study eligibility

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the employer place H-1B workers at third-party client sites, or do workers perform duties at the employer's own locations?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the petition will face the highest USCIS scrutiny category (third-party placement) associated with IT staffing and body-shop arrangements
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Treat as high-risk H-1B sponsorship; denial rates approaching 20% and RFE rates 35%+ apply to this model
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Proceed to evaluate employer-specific approval and RFE rates via USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub

diagnostic_questions.question: If the applicant is a bachelor's graduate, did they start their program before or after November 1, 2024?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether transitional protection may apply for students in fields removed from PGWP eligibility
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If started before November 1, 2024 in an affected field, assess transitional protection eligibility
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If started on or after November 1, 2024, verify that the field of study is on the current IRCC-approved eligible fields list

diagnostic_questions.question: What DOL wage level will the employer certify on the Labor Condition Application for this position?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the petition faces elevated RFE risk: Level I carries a 34.2% RFE rate versus 6.8% for Level IV
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If Level I: assess whether position genuinely qualifies as specialty occupation and whether negotiating to Level II or III is possible to reduce RFE risk
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If Level III or IV: substantially lower RFE exposure; verify the salary offer meets or exceeds the certified wage level

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the applicant's bachelor's field of study on the IRCC-approved eligible fields list post-November 1, 2024?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: PGWP eligibility for bachelor's degree graduates under the updated field of study requirements
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Applicant is eligible for a PGWP; assess program length to determine duration
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Applicant is not eligible for a PGWP unless transitional protection applies (started before November 1, 2024)

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the employer cap-exempt (university, affiliated research institution, government research organization, or nonprofit research organization)?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the applicant must compete in the annual H-1B lottery (85,000 cap, ~35.3% selection rate) or can receive H-1B status outside the cap at any time of year
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: H-1B petition can be filed at any time without lottery; no cap exposure; proceed to evaluate petition-specific approval factors
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Applicant must be registered in March lottery window; only ~35.3% chance of selection; backup status plan required

diagnostic_questions.question: Did the applicant submit their PGWP application before their study permit expired?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the applicant can legally work in Canada under maintained status during the approximately 8-month PGWP processing period
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Applicant may work under maintained status while PGWP is pending
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Applicant may lack authorization to work during processing and may have a status issue; urgent remediation required

diagnostic_questions.question: What is the employer's historical H-1B approval rate and RFE rate as shown in the USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Employer-specific sponsorship reliability; whether the employer falls in the high-approval (direct-hire tech: 97.4%) or low-approval (IT consulting: 78.2%, IT staffing: 60–75%) category
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If approval rate above 95%: low immigration risk from employer-side; proceed to evaluate wage level and role specifics
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If approval rate below 85%: materially elevated risk; weigh against alternative offers from higher-approval employers

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the PGWP holder's current employment classified as NOC TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the work experience is accumulating toward the 1 year of skilled Canadian work experience required for CEC eligibility
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Employment is CEC-eligible; track hours and duration toward the 1-year CEC threshold
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Employment in TEER 4 or 5 does not count toward CEC; candidate must secure TEER 0-3 employment to build Express Entry profile

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the applicant hold a US Master's degree or higher?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Eligibility for the 20,000-slot Master's cap exemption within the annual H-1B lottery, which provides an additional selection opportunity beyond the general 65,000-slot cap
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Applicant is eligible for both the general cap pool and the Master's cap pool, increasing overall selection probability
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Applicant competes only in the general cap pool of 65,000 slots; no additional lottery entries via Master's cap

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the Express Entry candidate relying on an LMIA-backed job offer for additional CRS points after Spring 2025?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate's CRS strategy accounts for the removal of LMIA arranged employment points
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Candidate must revise CRS strategy; LMIA job offer no longer yields CRS points; focus on core factors, French language, or PNP pathway
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Candidate is building CRS score through available mechanisms; assess French language score and PNP eligibility as highest-impact remaining options

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the employer enrolled in E-Verify?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the employer can legally sponsor STEM OPT extension, which is a separate requirement from H-1B sponsorship capability
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Employer is eligible to sponsor STEM OPT; proceed to evaluate H-1B sponsorship history
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Employer cannot sponsor STEM OPT extension regardless of H-1B sponsorship willingness; student may lose up to 24 months of additional work authorization

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the Express Entry candidate have TEF Canada or TCF Canada scores documenting French language proficiency?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Eligibility for French language CRS bonus, which can add 25-50+ points and is now one of the most impactful CRS optimizations available
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Calculate French language CRS bonus and incorporate into overall CRS assessment
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Candidate should assess feasibility of obtaining French proficiency to access this CRS advantage given removal of LMIA points

diagnostic_questions.question: What is the TEER level of your current or most recent Canadian job?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person is accumulating CEC-eligible work experience or spending their PGWP window in roles that do not qualify for the most common PR pathway
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If TEER 0-3: How many months have you accumulated? Are you on track to reach 12 months before your PGWP expires?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If TEER 4/5: How long have you been in this role? Do you have a plan to transition to a TEER 0-3 role, and does your remaining PGWP time allow for it?

diagnostic_questions.question: What is your country of birth, and have you modeled the employment-based green card backlog for your category?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines whether US-only strategy is viable long-term; India and China nationals face fundamentally different multi-decade timelines than all other nationalities
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you compared the US green card timeline against Canadian Express Entry processing time for your profile, and do you have a threshold at which you would pivot to Canada?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Before committing to a US-only strategy, calculate your estimated priority date wait using the USCIS Visa Bulletin and current cutoff dates — this changes the entire decision framework

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you calculated your current CRS score and compared it to recent Express Entry draw cut-offs by stream?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person understands their specific gap and which optimization levers (French, PNP, additional experience) are most efficient for their situation
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Which streams have you looked at? Have you included French-language proficiency draws and occupation-specific draws in your comparison?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: What is your education level, language score, and months of Canadian work experience? Let's calculate your score and identify the most efficient path to the relevant cut-off.

diagnostic_questions.question: How many H-1B lottery cycles do you have remaining before your OPT or STEM OPT expires?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines risk tolerance for cap-subject versus cap-exempt employer targeting; one remaining lottery attempt means zero margin for error and should trigger immediate pivot toward cap-exempt options
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If you have two or more attempts remaining, are you actively building a parallel cap-exempt employer pipeline as insurance while pursuing cap-subject roles?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If you have only one attempt remaining, have you identified at least three cap-exempt employers (universities, non-profit research organizations, government labs) that match your skill profile?

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you assessed your French language proficiency and calculated how many CRS points reaching CLB 7 would add?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person has considered the fastest available CRS optimization or is solely focused on work experience accumulation
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What is your current French level? How long would reaching CLB 7 realistically take given your current proficiency?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Your CRS gap may be closable faster through French than through additional work experience — this should be evaluated before committing to a multi-year waiting strategy.

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you searched your target employer's H-1B petition history on H1BData.info before accepting their offer?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Reveals whether the employer has proven compliance infrastructure, their denial and RFE rates, and the wage levels they have historically filed — directly predicts petition quality and compensation floor
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What was the employer's denial rate and RFE rate over the last three fiscal years, and how does their LCA wage for your role compare to the metro median?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: This data is public, free, and legally required to be disclosed — not checking it before accepting sponsorship is accepting avoidable risk on the most consequential career decision you will make

diagnostic_questions.question: Which province are you living and working in, and do you understand the PR pathway differences between provinces?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person is eligible for province-specific streams (BC PNP Tech, OINP Masters Graduate, SINP) that may offer faster or more accessible PR pathways than general Express Entry
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you mapped your NOC code against the specific draws available in your province? Are you tracking provincial draw frequency and cut-offs?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Provincial pathways can be significantly faster and less competitive than federal Express Entry — especially for smaller provinces. What is your NOC code and education level?

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the company that is declining to sponsor a small or mid-sized employer, and do you know whether their stated reason is policy or cost?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Distinguishes between genuine policy opposition and a cost/compliance objection that may be negotiable — the majority of small company refusals are cost-driven, not ideological
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you explored whether the company would reconsider if you offered to facilitate the immigration attorney relationship or if sponsorship cost could be structured differently?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Before walking away from an otherwise strong opportunity, ask the hiring manager directly: 'Is the concern about the cost and process, or is there a policy against sponsoring visas?' — the answer determines whether the objection is solvable

diagnostic_questions.question: When employers say they don't sponsor, do you explain that you hold an open work permit requiring no employer action?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person is losing job opportunities due to employer misunderstanding of PGWP rules rather than actual employer unwillingness to hire international graduates
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How do employers typically respond when you explain this? Are you still encountering rejections after the clarification?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: 22% of Canadian employers misunderstand PGWP rules — you may be self-eliminating from companies that would hire you if they understood no sponsorship is required. Prepare a one-sentence clarification for screening calls.

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you currently on H-1B with an approved petition, and are you staying at your employer primarily out of immigration fear?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines whether the candidate understands H-1B portability under AC21 — many H-1B holders vastly overestimate lock-in after first approval
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Do you understand that under AC21 portability you can begin work at a new employer immediately upon filing of a new petition, without waiting for approval and without re-entering the cap?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If you are not yet on H-1B, the lock-in concern is valid for your first petition — but you should be planning now for how you will use portability after approval to ensure you are not permanently bound to a first employer on unfavorable terms

diagnostic_questions.question: What is your PGWP expiry date, and have you mapped the time required for each PR pathway against that deadline?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person has a realistic timeline for achieving PR before their open work authorization expires, or is at risk of status gaps
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Which pathway are you targeting and what milestones need to be hit by what dates? What is your contingency if the primary pathway timeline slips?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Without a timeline map, there is a risk of reaching PGWP expiry without PR or a bridge pathway in place — this is one of the most common and consequential planning failures.

diagnostic_questions.question: What is the exact expiry date of your PGWP, and have you calculated whether you can receive PR before that date?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has a workable immigration runway or is already in a high-risk timeline squeeze
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What is your CEC eligibility date, and what is your current CRS score estimate — have you modeled whether that score is competitive in current draws?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Calculate immediately: PGWP expiry minus 18 months (1 year CEC accumulation + 6 months PR processing) = your hard deadline for starting a CEC-eligible job

diagnostic_questions.question: How many months remain on your PGWP, and are you currently in a TEER 0/1/2/3 role?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate's CEC window is still viable or already compromised; determines urgency level of Phase 1 intervention
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How many months have you been in that role? Are you on track to hit 12 months before your PGWP expires with enough runway to file?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: How long have you been searching? Have you considered broadening to any TEER 0/1/2/3 role rather than your target role specifically?

diagnostic_questions.question: Does your cold email opener reference something specific the recipient did, wrote, or said — or does it start with something about you or the company generally?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the message is genuinely personalized or a mass template — this is the single biggest predictor of response rate
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Is the specific reference recent enough to feel current, and does it connect naturally to your ask?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Find one specific thing this person did — a post, talk, article, or career move — before sending anything

diagnostic_questions.question: What percentage of your current job search activity is portal-based applications versus direct outreach and referral acquisition?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is operating in the 20–30% of the visible job market or actively pursuing the hidden 70–80%
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If mostly portal-based: What has your response rate been, and how many weeks have you been searching?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If direct outreach is occurring: What is your current cold email response rate and how many follow-ups are you sending per contact?

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the employer asked you to pay any fees associated with the H-1B petition or immigration process?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Immediate indicator of illegal conduct; this is a binary disqualifier regardless of any other positive signals from the employer
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Exit the arrangement immediately and consult an independent immigration attorney about your exposure
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Get this confirmed in writing as part of the offer process and continue additional due diligence

diagnostic_questions.question: Can you explain your most impactful project in 90 seconds in a way that would make a non-technical hiring manager want to know more?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has translated their technical work into communicable outcomes, and whether they have practiced the actual performance skill of narrating their work
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you practiced this out loud with another person in the last two weeks, or only rehearsed it mentally?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is the gap a lack of impactful projects, or a lack of practice articulating projects that do exist?

diagnostic_questions.question: How many months before your graduation date are you starting your job search?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student has enough runway to build warm referrals and relationships before immigration deadlines compress their options
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If 12+ months out: Are you actively networking or just beginning to plan?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If under 6 months out: Have you already identified which companies in your target list have a confirmed H-1B sponsorship track record?

diagnostic_questions.question: How many months of full-time CPT have you used to date, across all internships?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is at risk of or has already crossed the OPT-elimination threshold — the single most irreversible strategic error available to them
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If approaching 11 months, ask: have you consulted your DSO and ruled out any additional full-time CPT use?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If well under the limit, ask: do you understand that part-time CPT does not count, and are you tracking cumulative usage across all roles?

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you confirmed that the employer is willing to sponsor your H-1B, or are you still uncertain?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate's fear of negotiating is based on actual uncertainty about sponsorship or a false assumption that sponsorship is still contingent on their behavior
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Sponsorship is confirmed — treat it as a closed variable and negotiate compensation as you would as a domestic candidate
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Confirm sponsorship first as an operational check before entering any salary negotiation; do not mix the two conversations

diagnostic_questions.question: Which industry are you targeting, and are you using advice specific to that industry or general international student advice?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate's strategy is calibrated to the actual sponsorship and recruiting dynamics of their target industry
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What is the recruiting calendar for that industry, and have you mapped your application timeline against it?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: You may be applying tech-optimized advice to a non-tech context — revalidate your targeting, disclosure timing, and recruiting calendar

diagnostic_questions.question: Can you explain your most impactful project in 90 seconds in a way that would make a non-technical hiring manager want to know more?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has translated technical work into outcome-oriented language that survives cross-functional communication — a direct hiring manager filter
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What specific metric or outcome do you lead with, and how do you know it was impactful relative to alternatives?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is the barrier a lack of quantified outcomes in your work, or an inability to frame existing outcomes for a non-technical audience?

diagnostic_questions.question: What percentage of your current job search activity is online portal applications versus direct outreach or referral acquisition?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is accessing the full opportunity set or competing only for the 20–30% of positions that are publicly posted
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If mostly portals: What is your ATS pass-through rate and how many interviews has it generated in the last 30 days?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If balanced outreach: How many cold contacts have you followed up with at least three times?

diagnostic_questions.question: How many months before graduation are you starting your job search?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student's timeline is viable given OPT and H-1B deadlines — students who start less than 6 months out are already behind and need a compressed strategy
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If 12+ months out: are you already attending industry events and building relationships, or just planning to?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If less than 6 months out: have you identified your OPT start date and the H-1B March registration window relative to your graduation?

diagnostic_questions.question: Is your current or target job classified as T4 employment or T4A contractor?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the work experience being accumulated will count toward the 1-year CEC requirement for PR eligibility
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Confirm the employer has a CRA payroll account and that you are listed as an employee on their records
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Understand that contractor income does not count toward CEC — evaluate whether renegotiating classification or switching employers is necessary

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you independently looked up the NOC code for your current or target role on the IRCC NOC finder?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has confirmed CEC eligibility of their work experience or is operating on assumption based on job title
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What is the NOC code and TEER level? Does your employer's description of your duties match the NOC lead statement?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Do this immediately — especially if your title includes words like 'analyst,' 'coordinator,' or 'associate' which can be coded administratively

diagnostic_questions.question: What are you asking for in the final line of your cold message?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the ask is appropriately low-commitment or prematurely heavy — a job/referral ask in a first message is a reliable failure pattern
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If the ask is for a conversation: is it time-bounded (20 minutes) and tied to a specific topic?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If the ask is for a referral or job consideration: rewrite to ask only for a 20-minute call on a specific question

diagnostic_questions.question: Do you have quantifiable proof of worth you can reference in 1–2 sentences in a cold email?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has the background substance that makes outreach convert, independent of email writing quality
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What is the strongest single signal — a measurable project outcome, competition win, or prior employer name?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is the candidate doing outreach before building portfolio substance, which will cause even well-written emails to fail?

diagnostic_questions.question: Can the employer describe your specific job duties, SOC code, wage level, and worksite before filing?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the H-1B petition will be filed with accurate information or fabricated to create the appearance of a real position
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Verify that what they describe matches the actual work you'll be doing and that the wage level is consistent with the prevailing wage for that role and location
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: The employer cannot file a legitimate H-1B on your behalf; the offer is either premature or fraudulent

diagnostic_questions.question: Do you have a specific reason why you want to work at each company you are applying to, or are you casting wide?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is in a generic broadcast strategy or a targeted research-driven strategy; distinguishes candidates who will convert interviews from those who will not
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you spoken to at least one current employee at each of those companies in the last 6 months?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: How many of the companies on your list have you done substantive research on beyond reading their about page?

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you verified through USCIS public data or alumni intel which specific companies on your target list have actually filed and won H-1B petitions?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is operating on stated employer intentions or verified sponsorship behavior — these diverge significantly for small and mid-sized companies
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What is the approval rate and recency of those filings? Are they cap-subject or cap-exempt?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Your target list is unvetted; you are at risk of investing heavily in companies that cannot or will not execute sponsorship

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you verified the H-1B filing history of every company you are targeting for internships?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is filtering their target list by visa viability or purely by brand/interest — a critical upstream filter that changes the entire value of the internship strategy
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If yes, ask: what is the minimum annual H-1B filing volume you are accepting, and have you excluded companies below that threshold?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If no, redirect immediately to H1Bdata.info and MyVisaJobs.com before any further application activity

diagnostic_questions.question: Do you have a competing offer at a different compensation level?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has access to the most powerful negotiating tool available and whether they are choosing not to use it
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Establish whether they are planning to use it in negotiation; if not, identify and address the reason they're hesitating
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Shift strategy to market research, role scope framing, and exploring signing bonus and equity as alternative levers

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you verified sponsorship for each target employer using USCIS petition data, not just reputation or verbal assurances?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate's employer list is based on actual evidence or assumptions — reputation and size do not reliably predict sponsorship in non-tech industries
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What did the petition history show, and did you filter out firms with no prior H-1B filings?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Significant risk of investing time in non-sponsors, especially in finance boutiques and smaller consulting firms

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you spoken to at least one current employee at each of your target companies in the last 6 months?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is operating at steps 2–4 of the funnel (relationship-based) or defaulting to step 5 (application-based); reveals the actual state of their network at each target
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What did you learn from those conversations that changed how you're positioning yourself or which roles you're targeting?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: What is preventing outreach — absence of any connection point, fear of rejection, or belief that applications alone are sufficient?

diagnostic_questions.question: What proof of worth do you have that would make a hiring manager's inbox stop scrolling — quantified outcomes, notable employer, competition wins, OSS adoption?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has respond-worthy content to back their outreach, or whether better email writing alone will not move the needle
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If strong proof exists: Is it visible and specific in your outreach, or buried or generalized?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If proof is thin: What is the fastest path to a credible signal before scaling outreach volume?

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you verified that your target companies have a documented H-1B filing history using public USCIS data?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is operating on assumption or evidence — students who haven't done this verification are at high risk of late-stage disqualification
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If yes: what is the approval rate and volume — are these companies filing 5 H-1Bs a year or 500?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If no: the entire target list needs to be re-evaluated before more applications are sent

diagnostic_questions.question: Does your NOC code appear on the Global Talent Occupations List?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether post-PGWP employer sponsorship can be framed as a 2-week GTS process rather than a months-long LMIA — changes the employer conversation entirely
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Prepare a one-paragraph explanation of GTS Category B to share with HR if post-PGWP sponsorship concerns arise
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Identify whether a Category A GTS referral through a designated partner organization could apply, or plan around LMIA timeline risks

diagnostic_questions.question: Did you complete your degree at a Canadian institution, and if so, which province — and at what level (master's vs. bachelor's)?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines PNP stream eligibility — specifically whether the candidate qualifies for OINP Masters Graduate (no job offer required) or other province-specific graduate streams
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If Ontario master's: have you applied to OINP Masters Graduate stream? If not, why not — this is one of the most accessible PNP paths available.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Which province are you currently working in? Check if that province's PNP has a graduate stream for your institution type

diagnostic_questions.question: How many follow-ups did you send after the initial message, and how were they spaced?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has a real follow-up strategy or is abandoning contacts after one attempt — most conversions happen at touches 2 and 3
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If they sent follow-ups: were they adding new value (a question, an observation) or just bumping the thread?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If they sent no follow-ups: the response rate problem may be entirely attributable to lack of follow-through, not message quality

diagnostic_questions.question: When you reach out to someone for a referral, what exactly do you include and how long is your message?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is making the referral ask frictionless or creating work for the contact
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If they include resume, LinkedIn, and a pre-written context line: Is it under 150 words with a specific role identified?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If ask is vague or incomplete: Is the contact being asked to do research or writing work that reduces likelihood of follow-through?

diagnostic_questions.question: What is the company's policy on pay during bench periods between client placements?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the employer understands and intends to comply with H-1B wage regulations requiring pay for the entire validity period
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Get the policy in writing and confirm it matches the regulatory requirement under 20 CFR 655.731
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: The employer is either ignorant of or planning to violate H-1B wage requirements; either is a serious risk

diagnostic_questions.question: What is the exact timeline of your work authorization status, and have you communicated it clearly to recruiters?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has a clear grip on their visa constraints and whether those constraints have been proactively surfaced to recruiters, or whether they are being hidden or ignored
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have any recruiters screened you out based on visa status, and if so, are you targeting companies known to sponsor?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: How many months remain before your authorization deadline, and does your current search timeline account for that?

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you been in contact with international students from your program who graduated in the last 2–3 years?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is accessing the highest-quality, most current intelligence source available — people who solved the same problem recently in the same context
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What specific companies and recruiters have they identified as sponsor-friendly? Have any offered to refer you?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: This is your most actionable gap; reconnecting with recent international alumni should be your first networking priority

diagnostic_questions.question: What is your expected graduation date, and have you mapped the OPT start, H-1B lottery, and H-1B effective date sequence?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student understands the full authorization timeline they are asking a future employer to bridge — and whether their target companies have a demonstrated history of carrying employees through that period
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If yes, ask: have you confirmed with target companies that they have retained international employees through the OPT-to-H1B gap, including lottery losses?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If no, build the timeline together and use it to filter company targets by their demonstrated sponsorship continuity

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the employer a large company with standardized pay bands, or a smaller company with flexible compensation?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether base salary negotiation has a structural ceiling and which components (signing bonus, equity, job level, benefits) are worth pursuing instead
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Focus negotiation energy on signing bonus, equity, and job level rather than base salary
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Base salary has more flexibility; pursue a direct 5–15% counter before moving to other components

diagnostic_questions.question: Is your degree program STEM-designated for OPT purposes?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has 1 year or 3 years of OPT, which fundamentally changes the timeline and risk exposure before H-1B dependency
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Are you targeting employers who are familiar with STEM OPT extensions and willing to wait through the OPT window before H-1B filing?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: With only 1 year of OPT, your lottery exposure is immediate — prioritize large verified sponsors and consider cap-exempt employment as a contingency

diagnostic_questions.question: Do you know the exact timeline of your work authorization status and have you communicated it clearly to recruiters?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has internalized the OPT deadline as a hard constraint that compresses all other timelines, and whether they are managing recruiter expectations proactively
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you verified which of your target companies have a track record of sponsoring the specific visa type you will need?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: When is your OPT authorization deadline, and have you calculated backward from that date to determine when job search must have already begun?

diagnostic_questions.question: When you cold email a company and get no response, what do you do next?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has follow-up discipline and understands the funnel model, or treats non-response as rejection
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If they follow up: How many times, at what interval, and do they multi-thread to other contacts?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If they don't follow up: Are they systematically cutting off most of their potential conversions before the third-contact threshold?

diagnostic_questions.question: What percentage of your job search effort is going to networking and referral cultivation versus direct applications?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is using high-yield or low-yield channels — if the ratio is heavily skewed toward applications, the strategy is misaligned with where offers actually come from
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If networking is primary: who specifically are you targeting, and do you have any hiring manager contacts at your top companies?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If applications are primary: what is the callback rate, and have you connected with any international alumni from your program?

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you researched the PNP streams for the province where you are targeting jobs, and does your profile meet their eligibility criteria?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is optimizing for PR speed or defaulting to federal Express Entry without considering faster provincial pathways
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Quantify the CRS advantage of a PNP nomination (typically +600 points) and assess whether geographic targeting changes are worth making
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Research BC Tech Pilot, OINP Masters Graduate stream, and SINP occupation lists before finalizing geographic job search strategy

diagnostic_questions.question: What is your current French language proficiency level, and have you taken TEF Canada or TCF Canada?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Reveals whether the candidate has assessed or optimized their largest accessible non-PNP CRS lever post-LMIA removal
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What CLB level did you achieve? If CLB 7+ in all four skills, are you aware of dedicated Francophone draws and their lower cut-offs?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Have you taken any French courses? Estimate time to CLB 7 and calculate whether 25-50 CRS points is worth the investment given your current base score and cut-off gap

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you targeting individual contributors, managers, or executives in your outreach?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is targeting people who actually respond and hire versus visible but unreachable senior figures
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If targeting managers: are any of them newer in their role (joined in the last 12–24 months)?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If targeting executives: redirect toward managers 1–2 levels above the target role

diagnostic_questions.question: Who specifically are you targeting in your cold outreach — what title and how long have they been in that role?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is contacting the right level of decision-maker and prioritizing more receptive contacts
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If targeting managers with under 2 years tenure: Are they at the right company size tier (CEO for <30, recruiter for mid-size)?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If targeting Directors or VPs: Candidate is likely getting deflected rather than engaged with meaningfully

diagnostic_questions.question: How much OPT time do you actually have remaining, including any STEM extension eligibility?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is making a panic decision under artificial urgency or genuinely has no runway for continued legitimate job searching
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If significant OPT time remains, the true comparison is between this offer and 12+ more weeks of legitimate searching — reframe the decision accordingly
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If OPT is genuinely expiring, explore cap-exempt employment options (universities, nonprofits) before accepting any body shop offer

diagnostic_questions.question: How are you allocating your job search time across outreach and networking versus application submission versus research and resume work?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is investing in high-leverage Type A activities or defaulting to comfortable low-leverage Type C activities; surfaces whether the strategy matches the mental model
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How many cold outreach messages or informational interview requests did you send in the last two weeks?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: What is preventing you from doing more direct outreach — discomfort, lack of contacts, or uncertainty about how to approach it?

diagnostic_questions.question: At what stage of the hiring process are you currently disclosing your visa status?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is risking late-stage disqualification after significant sunk cost, or vetting efficiently early in the process
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If early: Are you framing it as a mutual benefit or as an apology?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If late or never proactively: You are accumulating sunk cost in processes that may end in preventable rejection

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you targeting finance, consulting, or tech — and do you know the recruiting calendar for your target industry?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is at risk of missing an industry's primary recruiting window due to calibrating to a different industry's timeline
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If targeting finance: ask whether they have begun outreach before August of their junior year and understand superday timing
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If uncertain: map out the specific application and offer deadlines for their target industry before they invest time in any other preparation

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you negotiating in the US under H-1B sponsorship, or in Canada with a PGWP?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has open work authorization (PGWP) and can negotiate identically to a domestic worker, or faces the H-1B sponsorship dynamic that requires deliberate reframing
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: PGWP: no sponsorship dynamic to manage; negotiate directly and compare offers accounting for CAD/USD exchange and healthcare value
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: H-1B: explicitly decouple the sponsorship confirmation from the salary negotiation to avoid weakening leverage

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you lost the H-1B lottery, and if so, how many times?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate needs to consider alternative immigration pathways, including cap-exempt employment
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you identified cap-exempt employers (universities, research nonprofits) in your field as a bridge option?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Continue primary strategy but build cap-exempt contingency into the plan from the start

diagnostic_questions.question: Can you give a specific reason — one that could not apply to any other company — for why you want to work at each company you are actively applying to?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has done genuine company research or is applying by brand recognition; predicts performance on 'why us' interview questions and whether outreach messages will read as authentic
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How did you develop that specific reason — through employee conversations, product research, or public information?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Are you applying to these companies because of genuine fit signals or because of name recognition and perceived safety in volume?

diagnostic_questions.question: At the companies where you most want to work, have you identified anyone with a school overlap, prior employer overlap, or shared community connection?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has mapped warm versus cold referral pathways and is prioritizing accordingly
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If warm connections exist: Have they been contacted, and was the ask made easy for them to execute?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If fully cold: Have you searched LinkedIn alumni filters, university career databases, and platforms like Exponent for referral portals?

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you spoken with any international students from your program who graduated 1–3 years ago and successfully obtained sponsorship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is accessing the highest-quality, most actionable intelligence available to them — this network is often the difference between targeted and generic search strategy
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If yes: which specific companies and recruiters did they identify, and have you reached out to those contacts?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If no: does the student know how to identify these alumni through the university career center or LinkedIn, and what's blocking the outreach?

diagnostic_questions.question: What is your current estimated CRS score, and what is the gap between your score and recent Express Entry cut-off scores for your eligible program?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is realistically competitive in federal Express Entry or needs a PNP pathway, language improvement, or job offer to close the gap
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Identify which CRS factors are improvable (language scores, French proficiency, job offer) and model the score impact of each
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Use IRCC's official CRS calculator to establish a baseline score before making any decisions about job targeting, province selection, or timeline planning

diagnostic_questions.question: What is your current estimated CRS score, and how does it compare to the most recent general draw cut-off?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines how large the gap is and which combination of levers can close it within the candidate's PGWP timeline
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If within 50 points: which single lever gets you there fastest — French proficiency, waiting for a second year of work experience, or a PNP stream?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Use the IRCC CRS calculator with your actual credentials before making any optimization decisions

diagnostic_questions.question: When did you send the referral ask relative to the first informational conversation?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is giving the relationship time to form before making a high-commitment ask, or collapsing it prematurely
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If 2–4 weeks later: did a relevant role open, and did you reference the earlier conversation specifically?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If during or immediately after the first call: the ask likely failed because no social obligation had been established yet

diagnostic_questions.question: How many follow-ups do you send after an unanswered cold email, and at what intervals?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate understands that conversion often happens at follow-up 2–3, not at the initial send
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If sending 3+ follow-ups at 3–4 day intervals: Are they multi-threading to other contacts after 3–4 attempts with no response?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If sending 0–1 follow-ups: Candidate is exiting pipelines that would likely have converted with persistence

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the company appear in H-1Bdata.info or USCIS employer data with a credible petition history?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the company's claims about being an H-1B sponsor are consistent with public federal records
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Check the denial rate and the occupations they've sponsored for — a company that sponsors only one SOC code narrowly may be a body shop even if real
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: The company has misrepresented its sponsorship history; treat all other representations with skepticism

diagnostic_questions.question: When did you begin building your network and target company list relative to your graduation or authorization deadline?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is in the early-networking compounding phase or the late-networking desperation phase; determines which strategies are still available to them
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you been able to demonstrate value back to contacts over that time, or has the relationship been one-directional?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Given the compressed timeline, which high-leverage activities should be prioritized immediately to recover as much relationship runway as possible?

diagnostic_questions.question: What percentage of your job search effort is going to direct outreach and networking versus submitting online applications?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student understands where job offers actually come from versus where activity is easiest to generate
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If networking-heavy: Are you reaching hiring managers or primarily HR contacts?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If application-heavy: With a sub-5% conversion rate on job boards, your current strategy cannot produce the outcomes you need within your immigration timeline

diagnostic_questions.question: During your current or most recent internship, have you explicitly told your manager you want to return full-time?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is relying on performance alone to signal return interest, or has made their intent explicit — the latter being a key input to manager advocacy
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If yes, ask: how did the manager respond, and have they proactively mentioned return offer timing or their own support?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If no and the internship is still ongoing, recommend an immediate natural-context conversation with the manager before the 4–6 week return offer window closes

diagnostic_questions.question: What is your internal framing when you think about asking for more money — professional negotiation or asking for a favor?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has internalized the fear-based frame ('I should be grateful') or the market-value frame ('I am a qualified professional negotiating compensation')
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Fear/favor frame: address the reframe explicitly before entering negotiation — the sponsorship decision and salary decision are separate
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Market-value frame: proceed to tactical advice on how to structure the ask, timing, and silence

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you geographically flexible, and does your target industry have geographic concentration?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether geographic constraints are artificially limiting the available pool of sponsoring employers, especially in biotech
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you prioritized the key geographic clusters for your industry in your job search?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Understand that geographic restriction in a concentrated industry (like biotech) dramatically reduces your viable employer pool

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you practiced behavioral interview responses out loud with another person in the last two weeks?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate has built the actual verbal fluency skill that interviews test, or whether they have only studied the framework — a distinction that predicts performance under real interview conditions
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What feedback did you receive, and what specific response weaknesses are you actively working on?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is the barrier access to a practice partner, belief that internal rehearsal is equivalent, or underestimation of how different live performance is from studied preparation?

diagnostic_questions.question: What seniority level are you targeting in your cold outreach, and how did you decide on that level?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate understands that contact seniority should be calibrated to company size and that Directors and VPs are systematically wrong targets
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If targeting managers: Are they filtering for managers who have been in role less than two years?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If targeting VPs or Directors: Are they getting responses, and have they tried manager-level contacts at the same companies?

diagnostic_questions.question: At what point in the application process do you disclose your visa status, and how do you frame it?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is managing disclosure strategically or reactively — both hiding it too long and leading with it as a burden are costly errors
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If disclosing early and directly: are you framing it as mutual benefit or as a request for a favor?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If avoiding disclosure: have you experienced late-stage rejections that could have been identified earlier?

diagnostic_questions.question: Do you have any French language ability, and have you calculated the CRS point impact of achieving a TEF/TCF score?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is leaving a directly controllable and potentially decisive CRS lever unused
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Calculate exact CRS score increase from current to B2/C1 French and compare the time investment to the PR timeline improvement it would yield
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Assess French language baseline — even moderate French (CLB 7-9) can add 25-50 CRS points, which may be the margin between receiving an ITA or not

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you currently in Quebec, or are you considering Montreal for your job search?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines whether the candidate needs to understand the Quebec-federal bifurcated immigration system and the CSQ requirement
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What is your French level? Do you understand the difference between CSQ, PRTQ, and federal Express Entry? Are you eligible for PRTQ if already employed in Quebec?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: No immediate action — but if considering Montreal, assess French proficiency investment before relocating

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you explicitly mentioning your OPT/visa status in outreach to companies you're researching for sponsorship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is pre-qualifying their targets efficiently or risking wasted effort on companies that won't sponsor
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Are you framing the visa status as a reason you specifically researched this company's sponsorship track record, or just disclosing it neutrally?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Consider whether early disclosure in informational outreach could actually filter for more receptive contacts and save time

diagnostic_questions.question: What is your specific ask at the end of your cold emails — can you state it in one sentence?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the ask is actionable and time-bound or vague, which directly determines response rate
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Does it include a specific format (call), timeframe (next two weeks), and duration (30 minutes)?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If the candidate struggles to state their ask clearly, the email likely lacks a concrete call to action

diagnostic_questions.question: Does your current or prospective contract include non-compete clauses or liquidated damages for resignation?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the employer is using contract terms as leverage to trap workers in exploitative conditions
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have an independent attorney review enforceability in your state before signing; do not sign under pressure
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Continue due diligence on other dimensions; absence of predatory contract terms is necessary but not sufficient

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you practiced behavioral interview questions using STAR format out loud with another person in the last two weeks?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate understands that interview performance is a perishable skill requiring active maintenance, or whether they believe knowledge of the framework substitutes for practiced execution
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What feedback did you receive, and what have you adjusted based on it?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Are upcoming interviews in your pipeline, and if so, what is the plan to build that skill before those interviews occur?

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you explicitly practiced STAR-format behavioral interview responses, or do you plan to improvise?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student has calibrated their preparation to how US hiring actually evaluates candidates, or is over-indexed on technical preparation
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How many full practice runs have you completed? Have you received feedback from someone familiar with US hiring norms?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Behavioral screens are a common failure point for international students regardless of technical strength; this gap needs to be closed before interviews begin

diagnostic_questions.question: Do you have a competing return offer, or is this your only return offer option?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student has any negotiating leverage — the presence of a competing offer is the primary lever available when base compensation is standardized
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If yes, ask: have you disclosed the competing offer to your preferred company and used it to open a compensation or benefit conversation?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If no, ask: is there a realistic path to a second return offer this cycle, and if not, what non-compensation terms (start date, location, team, signing bonus) are worth negotiating?

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the employer indicated that the offer is firm or non-negotiable?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate needs to redirect to alternative negotiation dimensions (signing bonus, equity, level) rather than directly countering base salary
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Ask about signing bonus, equity separately, and whether job level is negotiable; treat 'firm base' as a constraint on one variable, not all variables
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: The offer has not been declared firm; proceed with a direct salary counter using market rate research as justification

diagnostic_questions.question: For finance or consulting: are you targeting bulge-bracket or MBB-tier firms, or are you targeting boutiques?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate's target list is concentrated in reliable sponsors or distributed across firms with inconsistent or no sponsorship
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Good — but have you verified each firm individually rather than assuming tier equals sponsorship?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Boutique finance and consulting firms frequently do not sponsor; verify each one before investing recruiting effort

diagnostic_questions.question: How far in advance did you begin building your network at your target companies?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is in early-networking mode (authentic, reciprocal, time to discover unknown opportunities) or late-networking mode (high pressure, transactional, limited to currently available roles)
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What reciprocal value have you offered to contacts — introductions, relevant information, collaboration — that distinguishes you as a connector rather than just a job seeker?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Given the remaining time before your deadline, which relationship-building steps can still be completed meaningfully versus which require a different strategy?

diagnostic_questions.question: What is the specific ask in your cold emails — a conversation, an interview, or something vague like 'learning more about the process'?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the candidate is framing the relationship correctly (exploratory conversation) or triggering gatekeeping by asking for an interview or making a vague ask that requires the recipient to do interpretive work
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If asking for a conversation: Is the timeframe specific (e.g., 'within the next two weeks for thirty minutes')?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If the ask is vague or asks for an interview: What response rate are they achieving and does it match the 25–50% benchmark for high-personalization outreach?

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you practiced STAR-structured behavioral interview answers out loud with another person, or only thought through them internally?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is preparing for the actual interview format or underestimating how different verbal delivery is from internal reasoning
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If practiced out loud: have you received feedback on pacing, specificity, and cultural framing of your answers?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If only thought through: do you understand that US behavioral interviews are scored heavily on structure and delivery, not just content?

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you planning your CRS score around receiving LMIA job offer points?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Identifies whether the candidate is operating on outdated pre-March 2025 information and has an inaccurately high CRS projection

diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If no internship: prioritize internship applications immediately; a return offer from internship is the primary path to new grad full-time roles at top companies

diagnostic_questions.question: When did you start attending recruiting events and applying for internships relative to your program start date?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Reveals whether the candidate missed early-cycle opportunities (summer internships, return-offer pathways) that are disproportionately high-yield for international students
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If you have an internship, did you receive or pursue a return offer?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If you're now in your final year with no internship experience, pivot to targeting companies with rolling hiring or that explicitly hire new grads without prior US internships
